body.heading: Clarity is the point.
body.text: Medical technology deserves more than a headline. HealthCode brings together explanations, reviews, and practical learning resources for people curious about where healthcare goes next.

body.heading: Built for exploration.
body.text: This edition is a working editorial and technology demonstration. It showcases a content publishing system, a browsable knowledge library, and local research tools. It is not a healthcare provider, and it does not offer diagnosis or treatment.

body.heading: A thoughtful lens.
body.text: Imported demonstration stories are clearly identified. Product claims and clinical information should be checked against original research, official product documentation, and qualified professional advice.

body.heading: About this preview
body.text: This local edition does not collect messages or create accounts. There is no form that silently submits to an unavailable service.

body.heading: Find your next answer
body.text: Use Search or Ask the library to find relevant articles, reviews, and tools. Both search the available collection without sending your query to an external AI service.

privacy-policy.title:
Your space.
Your information.
privacy-policy.description: How this local preview handles information.

body.heading: On your device
body.text: Search queries, calculator values, worksheets, and images are processed locally. The preview does not send them to an AI provider or remote form service.

body.heading: Your reading list
body.text: Saved story identifiers are stored in your browser’s local storage. You can remove individual stories or clear your reading list at any time. Clearing browser data also removes the list.

body.heading: External links
body.text: Primary-source links open third-party websites with their own privacy practices. This preview has no analytics or tracking cookies. A deployed service would require a privacy review reflecting its actual hosting and integrations.

affiliate-disclosure.title:
Context matters.
So does disclosure.
affiliate-disclosure.description: A clear boundary between demonstration and evidence.

body.heading: Demonstration content
body.text: The imported review collection is retained to demonstrate editorial layouts and publishing behavior. Review scores, testing claims, product availability, and performance statements have not been independently verified.

body.heading: No buying advice
body.text: No affiliate tracking has been added to this local preview. Nothing here should be treated as a product endorsement or a substitute for independent research.
